Prevention: Aphids are small soft-bodied insects that vary in color from yellow to back.
When feeding from plant to plant, they can transmit viruses to the crop.
Grow clean healthy plants that are able to withstand attack by
Plant in a well prepared fertile field to promote crop vigour
Intercrop with onion, garlic, spider plant, coriander
Rotate with non-host crops e.g. maize, upland rice, sorghum, okra, sugarcane, and sunflower to prevent population build up.
Do not rotate with beans, cowpeas, lucerne, pigeon pea
Keep the fields free of weeds and alternative hosts such as wild mustards
Conserve natural enemies (e.g. flower bugs, lady bird beetles, praying mantis, hover flies, green lace wing, long horned grass hoppers and spiders
Monitoring: Monitor the crops during seedling, shoot growth, flowering and fruiting stages
Look for soft bodied insects (1 to 4 mm long), pear shaped, green, greenish brown or greenish black in colour
Examine the underside of the leaves and the bud areas for aphids and sooty molds
Look for curled leaves, abortion of flowers, stunted growth, dieback on foliage, inflorescences, and stems
Take action when 1-2 plants are infested during the first 2 months of the season
Direct Control: Remove aphid affected twigs along with aphid colony at the early stages of growth and destroy by burning
Place yellow basins half- filled with soapy water near the affected plants to attract and trap the winged aphids
Apply neem products (e.g. neem oil 40ml/20L water) maximum 2 times per month.
Start 15 days after transplanting reaching coverage of fruits and plants
Spray with soapy water solution (Mix 1 tablespoon of teepol with 4 litres of water, apply on the infested plants including the leaf undersides)
Restrictions: Wear protective clothing when handling chemicals
Follow instructions on the product label such as dosage, pre-harvest interval and appropriate time of application
Product unlikely to present hazard under conditions of normal use.
No more than 1 spray during flowering.
Toxic to bees and aquatic organisms
EC etc at the rate of 10-15mls/20L of water.
Contact pyrethroid pesticide with residual activity
